pages.text: An upgraded version of the default Sonic Boom. Hold $(thing)Shift$() while releasing to fire a barrage of amplified sonic waves in a wide arc, dealing devastating armor-piercing damage.$(br2)This skill consumes nearly all of your soul energy and will leave you at very low power afterward.$(br2)Like the default sonic boom, it will not harm villagers, players, or passive mobs.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Place the Soul Bow in a crafting table with an $(item)Echo Shard$() to begin the forging task.$(br2)You must prove your proficiency with the bow's default sonic boom skill. Check the tooltip for details.
